rules: Explicit booleans describe every permitted behavior. dry_run does not make a tool read-only when commit remains supported. Public ledger targets are covered; account-only/private-bank-only operations retain closed-world hints. Authorization and domain behavior are unchanged.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Runs BQL and formats its result; it does not commit ledger changes or consume the AI parsing quota.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Runs BQL and returns typed rows; it does not commit ledger changes or consume the AI parsing quota.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Lists the authenticated account's accessible ledger metadata without modifying its memberships or ledgers.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Confined to the current account's accessible-ledger catalog; no public search or arbitrary destination is accepted.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Computes existing ledger validation errors without committing any change.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Reads ledger files, accounts and context without changing ledger contents.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Reads the selected entry and its surrounding source without changing it.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Lists and filters existing journal entries without adding or deleting entries.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Lists existing repository paths without creating, renaming or deleting files.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Reads selected existing file contents without changing them.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Appends directives and may add include lines in the selected ledger.
justifications.destructiveHint: Only adds ledger directives/include references; it does not replace or remove existing entries.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated calls can append duplicate directives; no general idempotency key is required.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Appends supplied directive text to the selected ledger.
justifications.destructiveHint: Only appends text and needed include references; existing text is not replaced or deleted.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated calls can append the same text again.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Copies a caller-owned upload to receipt storage, appends an entry and consumes the temporary upload.
justifications.destructiveHint: After successful entry commit it deletes the original temporary upload; preserving a permanent copy does not make that deletion additive.
justifications.idempotentHint: No repeat-safe transaction guarantee: when the temporary cleanup fails, another call can append again.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Sends the caller-owned upload for extraction/account recommendations and consumes persisted AI quota.
justifications.destructiveHint: It does not delete or overwrite ledger entries or the source upload; AI usage is disclosed as a stateful cost.
justifications.idempotentHint: A repeated parse can consume additional AI quota and produce another model result.
justifications.openWorldHint: Sends the selected upload for processing by configured external AI providers, beyond ledger-local execution.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Processes a caller-owned upload through AI and consumes persisted AI quota.
justifications.destructiveHint: It returns parsed rows without deleting the upload or replacing/deleting ledger entries; quota consumption is disclosed.
justifications.idempotentHint: A repeated parse can consume additional AI quota and produce another model result.
justifications.openWorldHint: Sends selected upload contents to configured external AI processing providers.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Issues a new caller-bound presigned PUT capability and unique temporary object key.
justifications.destructiveHint: The capability targets a fresh temporary key; this call does not overwrite/delete an existing object or commit an entry.
justifications.idempotentHint: Each invocation issues a new temporary key and PUT capability.
justifications.openWorldHint: Confined to the caller-owned service temporary-upload namespace; no arbitrary destination or public publication is accepted.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Commits new files to the selected ledger.
justifications.destructiveHint: Creates new paths; an already existing target is refused rather than overwritten.
justifications.idempotentHint: No general successful retry guarantee; existing targets are refused.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Commits replacements to existing ledger files.
justifications.destructiveHint: Replaces existing file contents, even when a commit can later be reverted.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating the same replacements converges to the requested file contents.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Commits removal of selected ledger files.
justifications.destructiveHint: Deletes existing paths and content; include guards limit but do not remove that destructive capability.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeated deletion cannot remove additional paths beyond the supplied targets; an already absent target may be refused.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Commits replacement source for an existing entry.
justifications.destructiveHint: Overwrites existing entry text; optimistic hashes and optional previews do not change the committed branch's effect.
justifications.idempotentHint: No general retry guarantee is offered for entry/hash-addressed edits; the addressed source/hash changes after commit.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Commits removal of one selected entry's source.
justifications.destructiveHint: Deletes an existing entry; optional dry_run is not the only accepted mode.
justifications.idempotentHint: No general retry guarantee is offered for entry/hash-addressed deletion; the original target is consumed.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Commits removal of several selected entry sources.
justifications.destructiveHint: Deletes existing entries in the committed mode, regardless of preview support.
justifications.idempotentHint: No general retry guarantee is offered for hash-addressed batch deletion; targets and file hashes change.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Commits a new path and removal of the original, optionally rewriting include directives.
justifications.destructiveHint: Deletes the old path and can overwrite includer contents; content preservation and a reversible commit do not make this additive.
justifications.idempotentHint: The old source is consumed; repeating identical arguments cannot rename another file or repeat include rewrites, though it may return NOT_FOUND.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Sets or removes the caller's personal ledger-star relationship.
justifications.destructiveHint: starred:false removes an existing star relationship; reversibility does not make removal additive. It never deletes the ledger.
justifications.idempotentHint: Sets a requested boolean relationship state; repeating the same value has no additional domain effect.
justifications.openWorldHint: Only changes the current user's private preference, even when the referenced ledger is public.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Fetches configured public price feeds and updates derived refresh/cache status.
justifications.destructiveHint: Refreshes derived feed data/status only; it does not delete source configuration or replace authored ledger files/entries.
justifications.idempotentHint: With unchanged feed data, refresh converges to the same derived price state; operational timestamps do not create extra ledger entries.
justifications.openWorldHint: Fetches configured market-data feed origins, which are public/external sources.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Fetches provider changes, creates/modifies/removes staged rows and advances the stored sync cursor.
justifications.destructiveHint: Applies modified provider rows and deletes removed staged transactions; it is not only an additive fetch.
justifications.idempotentHint: Provider data, cursor and staged state may advance; a repeat is a new synchronization without a caller idempotency key.
justifications.openWorldHint: Contacts the linked external bank provider and persists its returned changes.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Appends selected staged rows as ledger entries and marks their source rows as synced.
justifications.destructiveHint: Adds ledger entries and retains the source transaction records with import status; it does not replace/delete authored entries.
justifications.idempotentHint: Successful import marks source rows synced; a general replay of arbitrary selected rows is not promised.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Removes selected rows from bank staging.
justifications.destructiveHint: Deletes stored staged transaction records.
justifications.idempotentHint: No general successful retry guarantee for an already consumed staged-id set.
justifications.openWorldHint: Only changes caller-authorized private bank staging, never a public ledger or arbitrary outside destination.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Reconciles stored bank accounts against the provider's current account set.
justifications.destructiveHint: Can remove obsolete bank-account records and replace their associated state.
justifications.idempotentHint: Reconciliation observes current provider state and can remove/change records again as it changes.
justifications.openWorldHint: Reconciles against the linked external bank provider's account set.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Sets a linked bank account's target ledger-account mapping.
justifications.destructiveHint: Can overwrite an existing mapping, changing how later imports are classified.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating the same mapping converges to that stored target.
justifications.openWorldHint: Only sets an authorized account's private bank-to-ledger mapping; it does not publish ledger content.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Sets the stored currency for the selected bank account.
justifications.destructiveHint: Can overwrite an existing currency choice used by subsequent imports.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating the same currency converges to that stored value.
justifications.openWorldHint: Only changes an authorized bank account's private currency metadata.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Refreshes the existing provider link's derived status and errors.
justifications.destructiveHint: Does not unlink the bank, revoke access or replace authored ledger content; it refreshes existing derived status only.
justifications.idempotentHint: With unchanged provider state, refresh converges to the same connection status; it creates no new bank link.
justifications.openWorldHint: Contacts the external provider for current connection status.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Removes the bank connection and its local related records and revokes provider access.
justifications.destructiveHint: Revokes access and deletes connection/account data.
justifications.idempotentHint: Revokes/consumes the original connection; no general successful replay guarantee is offered.
justifications.openWorldHint: Revokes the existing connection at the external bank provider as well as changing local records.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Reads the caller-authorized existing bank links/accounts; it does not refresh, link or unlink a bank.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Only reads authorized private bank-link/account records; ledger visibility does not expose these records publicly.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Reads caller-authorized staged bank rows without fetching, importing or discarding them.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Only reads authorized private bank staging, not public ledger entries or arbitrary external endpoints.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Creates a fresh proposal branch, its proposed files and a new pull request.
justifications.destructiveHint: Changes are isolated to the newly created branch; the existing base branch and existing pull requests are not overwritten/closed.
justifications.idempotentHint: Creates a fresh branch and proposal on each invocation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Merges proposed changes into the existing base branch.
justifications.destructiveHint: Can overwrite or remove existing base-branch content as the proposal is applied.
justifications.idempotentHint: No general replay guarantee for an already merged proposal; merging changes the addressed base/proposal state.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Closes the selected existing pull request without merging it.
justifications.destructiveHint: Cancels/closes an existing proposal, changing its lifecycle state.
justifications.idempotentHint: No general replay guarantee for an already closed proposal is offered.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Creates a new ledger and requested initial files.
justifications.destructiveHint: Adds a new repository; existing ledgers are not overwritten or removed.
justifications.idempotentHint: requestId is optional; calls without it are not guaranteed to deduplicate.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Computes proposed setup files and validation in memory; it creates no ledger, file or job.
justifications.destructiveHint: No ledger, relationship, source data or external domain state is mutated by this read/preview.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating this read/computation introduces no domain mutation.
justifications.openWorldHint: Pure setup computation over supplied structured parameters, without publication or external destination.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Changes existing ledger metadata or privacy.
justifications.destructiveHint: Can replace settings, rename the ledger or change its visibility; optional preview does not limit committed capabilities.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating the requested settings converges to those values; rename validation may refuse stale identifiers.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Permanently removes an existing ledger and its history.
justifications.destructiveHint: Deletes the ledger, contents and history in committed mode.
justifications.idempotentHint: Consumes the ledger and identifier; no successful replay guarantee is offered.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Adds a collaborator or updates their stored permission.
justifications.destructiveHint: Can replace/downgrade existing access; adding-only is not the sole accepted behavior.
justifications.idempotentHint: Repeating the same collaborator permission converges to that grant.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Removes an existing collaborator's access.
justifications.destructiveHint: Revokes the selected collaborator's permission in committed mode.
justifications.idempotentHint: Consumes the existing grant; no general successful replay guarantee is offered.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

justifications.readOnlyHint: Removes the authenticated collaborator's own access.
justifications.destructiveHint: Revokes the caller's existing access in committed mode.
justifications.idempotentHint: Consumes the caller's existing grant; no general successful replay guarantee is offered.
justifications.openWorldHint: Can target a publicly visible ledger/repository; the static hint covers that allowed path as well as private targets.

boundary: Per-tool explanations for the original application; no deployed fix, platform rescan, accepted resubmission, approval or public/native publication is claimed.
